title: PPTX Conversion Trace Report (future contract; not active export instrumentation)
description: Clean-room SHAPE contract for a per-primitive PPTX conversion trace report. This schema is intentionally idea-only today: scripts/export_pptx.py does NOT emit a trace yet, and no other script in this repo reads one. The contract pins what a future trace MUST carry so that, when runtime tracing is wired in, the writer and any reader agree on the on-disk shape from the first commit. The pipeline_status literal 'future_contract_only' locks that intent at the file boundary; the read-only validator at scripts/validate_conversion_trace.py re-applies the same gate so a future runtime path cannot silently re-interpret an existing trace as if it were live. Every record describes one render_model primitive's attempted conversion to a PPTX surface: the source slide_index / primitive_id, the primitive_kind from the render_model allow-list, the expected_pptx_kind the exporter would have produced, the conversion status (editable / rejected / degraded / skipped), a closed-enum reason_code when status != editable, and evidence fields that can be sampled without opening PowerPoint (booleans on supported-ness and bounds, integer counts, the relationship type the primitive would have triggered). Trace, deck, and generator ids are forced to start with the literal 'synthetic_' prefix so a trace can never be authored under a real document id. No URL / file path / data: URI / credential-shape / public-upload / raw-source / confidential wording is permitted anywhere; the schema patterns refuse the obvious shapes and the validator re-applies the same canonical-form gates. This is NOT upstream parity (no upstream trace schema was opened) and NOT active export instrumentation (export_pptx.py and validate_pptx_contract.py do not consume or produce this file today). See references/conversion-trace-contract.md.

schema_version.description: Trace schema version. Bump only with a paired contract change.

trace_id.description: Stable trace identifier. The forced 'synthetic_' prefix refuses any real-document id at the schema layer; the validator denylist mirrors it. Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and underscore only.

pipeline_status.description: Hard literal. This field locks the document at the SHAPE-only contract layer — no script in this repo writes or reads a trace as runtime state today. The validator re-asserts the literal so a future runtime path must flip it in a paired contract change rather than silently reusing the existing value.

generated_by.description: Identifier for the synthetic writer of the trace. 'name' carries the forced 'synthetic_' prefix; 'mode' is a closed enum that names whether the trace was assembled by a self-test scenario or by manual authoring against the fixture pattern.

deck.description: Deck-level metadata the trace describes. slide_count is informational (cross-checked against the maximum record.slide_index by the validator). layouts_attempted is the closed set of layout ids the exporter is expected to consume today — chart-only or otherwise unsupported layouts are not in this allow-list.

records.description: Ordered list of per-primitive conversion records. Every entry describes one render_model primitive attempt. Validator enforces uniqueness of (slide_index, primitive_id) across all records and reason_code consistency vs. status.

slide_index.description: 1-based slide index that ties this record back to render_models/<idx:02d>_<layout>.json (and to deck_plan.slides[].index).

slide_layout.description: Layout id this slide uses. Closed enum is enforced at the deck.layouts_attempted level; here the field is left as the generic layout-id pattern so a future schema extension can widen the allow-list in one place.

primitive_id.description: Stable primitive id, ties to render_model.primitives[].id. Unique within (slide_index, primitive_id) across the whole trace; the validator enforces this.

primitive_kind.description: Mirror of the render_model.primitives[].kind closed enum. New kinds may not be added without a schema bump on both render_model.schema.json and here.

expected_pptx_kind.description: Closed enum naming the surface the exporter is expected to emit for this primitive. 'native_image_placeholder' reflects today's exporter — image_slot is a placeholder shape carrying alt_text, with media embedding TODO. 'raster_fallback' is reserved for a future degraded path; 'none' is used with status=rejected/skipped when no PPTX surface is emitted.

status.description: Closed enum. editable: the primitive was emitted as a native, in-PowerPoint editable surface. rejected: the exporter refused the primitive (fail-closed contract gate). degraded: emitted, but with a known loss vs. the render_model (e.g. raster fallback). skipped: the primitive was intentionally omitted (e.g. media embedding TODO).

reason_code.description: MUST be null when status=editable; MUST be one of the closed enum strings when status in {rejected, degraded, skipped}. The validator re-asserts this consistency rule; the schema only enforces enum membership.

evidence.description: Evidence fields that can be sampled without opening PowerPoint. Boolean gates (supported / within-canvas / alt-text-present) and small integer counts (shape / text-run / table-row deltas) are obtainable by reading the OOXML XML parts directly. Nullable fields use null when the field is not meaningful for the primitive kind (e.g. text_run_count is null for a line primitive).

relationship_type.description: Closed enum mirrors scripts/validate_pptx_contract.py relationships.allow_list. null when this primitive did not trigger a package relationship.

note.description: Optional terse synthetic note. Validator refuses URL / file path / credential / public-upload / raw-source / confidential wording here, same as the rest of the trace.

summary.description: Per-status totals. Validator cross-checks these against the records list — a trace whose summary disagrees with its own records is refused.

notes.description: Optional trace-level note. Same content gates as record.note.
